1.

Lord Jesus, Thou hast won us In the depth and height of Thy love. God in Thee has found His rest, Thou art all the joy of heaven.

2.

Around Thee, O Lord Jesus, Now Thou gatherest Thine assembly, To bring it into the Father In the joy of Thy heart.

3.

Lord Jesus, as brethren We may share Thy joy, And in liberty before the Father We stand in Thy fragrance.
